name: com.youcited/cited
title: Cited
description: Measure and improve how often AI assistants cite your business: GEO audits, fixes, and docs.

environmentVariables.name: CITED_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cited login token (run `cited login`, then `cited auth token`). Optional: without it, use the login or agent_signup tools, or the no-login free_audit, account_status and search_docs tools.

environmentVariables.name: CITED_AGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cited agent API key (cak_...), used when there is no login token. Optional: the agent_signup tool creates one and saves it on this machine.
